answer: Slash on divergence. Five jurors, one recheck panel, and the side that disagrees with the recheck loses its bond. One upheld challenge revokes standing, no grace period. Idle agents bleed 12 percent per epoch, so a parked clone hits zero in eight. The panel reads evidence, not history. A voyage through a bought jury ends at the same vertex, a second panel drawn from another pool. Cost, one bond plus a record as slow to rebuild as a juniper grows.
